Northeastern University is hiring a Research Engineer to help build the SPHERE cybersecurity and privacy research infrastructure, focusing on an Internet of Things (IoT) experimentation testbed. The role develops and maintains software, supports project coordination and demonstrations, and helps enable scalable remote access to IoT devices for research.

Software Development Activities (70%): Design, implement, test, document, and maintain SPHERE software
Support Activities (20%): Prepare project documentation and periodic reports, coordinate with project partners, and prepare and present testing demonstrations
Learning (10%): Acquire and broaden knowledge of the technologies and development tools used by SPHERE
